Reranking

Reordering an existing set of retrieved candidates by relevance to the question.

In practice

For a refund-timing question, move the timing passage ahead of general application conditions.

What to check

Check whether the correct passage was retrieved first. Compare candidate order before and after reranking on representative questions.

Common confusion

Reranking cannot recover a missing candidate. Its scores do not establish truth or replace access and version filters.
